rounds.text: This massive earnings acceleration is further reinforced by a trailing twelve-month profit growth surge of 572% and a rules-based screen highlighting a 350% year-on-year net profit increase [E21, E66]. Operating margins are expanding structurally, rising to 6% in March 2026—a 4-percentage-point increase over three years—alongside a quarterly margin of 9% [E30, E31]. Cash generation is exceptionally robust, demonstrated by a Mar 2026 cash conversion ratio of 4.35x that yielded Rs 148 Cr in operating cash flow and Rs 89 Cr in free cash flow, proving that profits are fully backed by hard cash [E34, E35, E36]. Institutional confidence is visibly mounting as foreign and domestic institutions have increased their stakes by 1.18 and 6.82 percentage points respectively since September 2023, while promoter holdings have also risen to 45.12% [E41, E42, E43]. Conceded: [E45] and [E46] show a discounted cash flow intrinsic value of Rs 24 per share against a market price of Rs 36.1, implying a negative margin of safety.
